Coding agent risks with Vercel: replays and fixes

1 replay involves Vercel: 0 reported incidents and 1 command class. Each one shows the call, a fix that needs no extra tool, and what KYA did in the replay.

  • Vercel project removal

    Fix: Use a Vercel access token for the one team the agent works in, and not a token for your whole account. Keep the code in Git and a copy of the project settings and environment variables outside Vercel, so a removed project can be set up again.

    Replay result: Stopped.
